ns2:course.label: Colloquium in Advertising
ns2:course.description: Current topics, cases, and research in advertising are presented in a forum that fosters critical thinking and engagement. Weekly presentation and discussion of current research and cases by faculty, undergraduate/graduate students, visiting scholars and visiting professionals. 1 undergraduate hour. No graduate credit. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated up to 2 hours in separate terms, if topics vary. Prerequisite: ADV 281 and consent of instructor.
